remarks: Renovated & Spacious 3-Bedroom End-Unit Condo in Prime Central Location - Top School District!  Welcome to this stunning, fully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo perfectly situated in the heart of town. Offering generous living space, modern upgrades, and unbeatable convenience, this home is ideal for anyone seeking comfort and style with easy access to everything. Step inside to discover an open-concept layout featuring a bright and airy living room, large windows that flood the space with natural light. The renovated kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, ample cabinetry, and a spacious island - perfect for entertaining or casual dining. The primary suite with vaulted ceilings offers a private retreat with ample closet space and a beautifully updated en-suite bathroom. Two additional well-sized bedrooms provide plenty of room for family, guests, or a home office. Additional highlights include second-floor laundry, central air conditioning, and a fully finished basement offering almost 400sf of additional living space! This well-maintained home is located just minutes from shopping, dining, transit, parks, and top-rated schools.
